cases.explain: Стрелы is the direct object of the transitive verb сокрушил (broke), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: От грозного крика твоего ___ упали замертво.
cases.explain: Конь is the grammatical subject performing the action упали (fell), requiring the nominative.
The preposition пред (before) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Твой гнев на ___ принесет тебе хвалу.
cases.explain: The preposition на (upon) with 'people' in this construction uses the genitive case.

reading.question: Where is God known, according to the text?
reading.explain: The text states 'В Иудее известен Бог' — In Judah, God is known.

reading.ru: Там он сокрушил сверкающие стрелы, щит и меч, орудия войны.
reading.question: What instruments of war did God break?
reading.explain: The passage lists 'сверкающие стрелы, щит и меч, орудия войны' — flaming arrows, shield, and sword.

reading.ru: Ни один из них не смог даже руку поднять.
reading.question: What could none of the warriors do?
reading.explain: The text says 'Ни один из них не смог даже руку поднять' — Not one of them could even lift their hand.

reading.question: Who alone should be feared?
reading.explain: The verse states 'Лишь тебя надо бояться' — Only you should be feared.

reading.ru: Ты произнес суд с небес, вся земля испугалась и притихла.
reading.question: What happened to the earth when God pronounced judgment from heaven?
reading.explain: The text says 'вся земля испугалась и притихла' — the whole earth was afraid and became silent.

reading.ru: Все, кто вокруг него, приносите дары грозному.
reading.question: What should those around God do?
options: Bring gifts to him who is awesome
reading.correct: Bring gifts to him who is awesome
reading.explain: The verse commands 'приносите дары грозному' — bring gifts to the awesome one.
